description: This file defines the Coupon class in the OpenCart system, implementing methods for calculating discounts based on coupons during checkout, confirming coupon usage, and reversing coupon application. It interacts with session data, models, and tax calculations relevant to coupons and order totals.

classes.name: Coupon
classes.description: A model class responsible for managing coupon discount calculations, application, validation, and reversal within the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It relies on session data, other models, and the tax component.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Calculates and applies coupon discounts to the order totals, adjusting taxes accordingly, if a coupon is set in the session.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Validates and records the application of a coupon for an order based on its title containing the coupon code.

methods.name: unconfirm
methods.description: Removes coupon usage histories associated with a specific order, effectively reversing the coupon discount.
